title: AIDP journey profile selection
description: Machine-local configuration selecting the mock or real_smoke profile for PW-KB-AIDP-01. The suite worker resolves the selected profile before any preparation, records it into the case evidence and derives the effective required mock services from the case contract.

selected_profile.description: mock drives the real product against the controlled AIDP mock (ext-knowledge instance); real_smoke drives it against an explicitly configured real AIDP deployment.

real_smoke.description: Oracle definition for the real_smoke profile; every field is required when that profile is selected. No developer-specific IDs are hardcoded in the repository.

kb_id.description: kds_id of the real test knowledge base

kb_name.description: Display name of the real test knowledge base

doc_name.description: Optional document name verified in the file-management view

query.description: Fixed question answered by the expected text

expected_text.description: Stable text fragment the real retrieval must return

expected_source.description: Source document title expected in the citation
